lines.say: Your city now charges you for every step you take.
Ten cents a step. The sidewalk counts every one.
Your walk to work costs eighty dollars a day. You earn sixty.
Then you see Doris from six C. She is walking. And smiling.
She's walking backwards. Every step backwards is a refund.
By Friday the whole city walks to work backwards.
Would you walk backwards to work? Write it in the comments.
